name: Who Killed My Father Academy!
source:
You like stories, right? Of course you do, or else you wouldn't be here. I have a proposition for you - just hear me out for a second.

I just transferred to [REDACTED] Academy, a boarding school for the most elite and (occasionally) gifted students across the country. Today, February 12th, 2014, is my first day. Changing schools right in the middle of the year is tough, especially since the entire student council seems to want a piece of me, but that's not what I need your help with.

You see, someone in this school killed my father, and I won't stop searching until I find out who.

[From [url=https://ntagonistic.itch.io/wkmfa]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你喜欢故事，对吧？当然可以，不然你也不会在这里。我有一个建议给你——请听我说完。

我刚刚转到[REDACTED]学院，这是一所寄宿学校，招收全国最精英和（偶尔）有天赋的学生。今天，2014年2月12日，是我上班的第一天。在年中转校是很困难的，尤其是整个学生会似乎都想从我身上分一杯羹，但这不是我需要你帮助的事情。

你看，这所学校里有人杀了我父亲，在查出是谁之前我不会停止搜寻。

[来自[url=https://ntagonistic.itch.io/wkmfa]itch.io[/url]]
